# Awesome DSH Plugin > 以双语元数据整理跨场景插件候选 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin) - **版本号**：未声明（[固定提交 3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/tree/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6)） - **版本日期**：2026-08-15（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核查固定提交的按用途定位可独立核查的插件来源。未执行目标代码或实际宿主验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：用户按用途寻找 DSH 插件。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 统一双语目录及可复查元数据。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 收录状态需回到实际包核验。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 可缩短发现候选时间。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 固定提交抽样核对来源和双语。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 统一双语目录及可复查元数据。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 收录状态需回到实际包核验。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 可缩短发现候选时间。 保留人工判定表。 ## 场景与替代办法 用户按用途寻找 DSH 插件。 GitHub 自由搜索。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | DSH 宿主 | 必需 | JSON 分类和验证生成目录。 | 用隔离 profile 确认 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 用户按用途寻找 DSH 插件。 | 保留原流程 | | 试验 | JSON 分类和验证生成目录。 | 观察固定版本 | | 复核 | 固定提交抽样核对来源和双语。 | 比对任务结果 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 安装与运行成本未知 | 配置准备耗时未知 | 视 profile 而定 | | 持续 | 持续运行成本未知 | 日常维护耗时未知 | 视任务频率而定 | | 恢复 | 回退成本未知 | 恢复原流程耗时未知 | 视已有数据而定 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 按用途定位可独立核查的插件来源 | 可缩短发现候选时间。 | 固定提交抽样核对来源和双语。 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：按用途定位可独立核查的插件来源 ### Q01 · 目录帮助谁？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 初次选插件的用户可先按用途浏览，再到来源检查。相对自由搜索，目录提供统一分类和双语说明。验收应抽样确认同一名称和来源在两种语言中一致。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:6-10](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/blob/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6/README.md#L6-L10) 作者说明跨场景社区目录 ```text > A community-curated, vendor-neutral catalog of plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — from developer tooling and data workflows to media, operations, and everyday life. **Language:** English | [简体中文](docs/README.zh-CN.md) DeepSeek Harness plugins can connect an agent to tools, services, devices, and repeatable workflows. This list is intentionally broad: if it gives an agent a useful real-world capability, it belongs here. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[scripts/generate_readmes.py:49-58](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/blob/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6/scripts/generate_readmes.py#L49-L58) 双语字段必填
查看原文（10行） ```text def require_localized(value: Any, label: str) -> dict[str, str]: if not isinstance(value, dict): fail(f"{label} must be an object with en and zh-CN text.") result: dict[str, str] = {} for language in LANGUAGES: text = value.get(language) if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip(): fail(f"{label}.{language} must be a non-empty string.") result[language] = text.strip() return result ```
#### 缺口 - 收录范围未独立对照。 **影响**：降低候选整理成本。 **进一步探讨**：对照同任务搜索结果。 ### Q02 · 如何维护？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 JSON 为分类和条目输入，生成器检查类别 ID、双语文本和重复名。中文页面由指定生成目标维护。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[scripts/generate_readmes.py:16-23](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/blob/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6/scripts/generate_readmes.py#L16-L23) 输入、输出和状态枚举 ```text ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] CATALOG_PATH = ROOT / "catalog" / "plugins.json" MARKERS = ("", "") LANGUAGES = ("en", "zh-CN") PAGES = {"zh-CN": ROOT / "docs" / "README.zh-CN.md"} SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$") STATUSES = {"active", "beta", "archived"} SOURCES = {"official", "community"} ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[scripts/generate_readmes.py:61-90](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/blob/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6/scripts/generate_readmes.py#L61-L90) 类别和条目验证
查看原文（30行） ```text def validate(catalog: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]]: categories: list[dict[str, Any]] = [] category_ids: set[str] = set() for index, category in enumerate(catalog["categories"], start=1): label = f"categories[{index}]" if not isinstance(category, dict): fail(f"{label} must be an object.") category_id = category.get("id") if not isinstance(category_id, str) or not SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(category_id): fail(f"{label}.id must be a lowercase kebab-case string.") if category_id in category_ids: fail(f"Duplicate category id: {category_id}") category_ids.add(category_id) categories.append({"id": category_id, "title": require_localized(category.get("title"), f"{label}.title")}) grouped: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list) names: set[str] = set() urls: set[str] = set() for index, plugin in enumerate(catalog["plugins"], start=1): label = f"plugins[{index}]" if not isinstance(plugin, dict): fail(f"{label} must be an object.") name = plugin.get("name") url = plugin.get("url") category = plugin.get("category") if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip(): fail(f"{label}.name must be a non-empty string.") if name.casefold() in names: fail(f"Duplicate plugin name: {name}") names.add(name.casefold()) ```
#### 缺口 - 英文与中文具体同步范围需核对。 **影响**：便于结构化消费。 **进一步探讨**：按固定提交对账。 ### Q03 · 哪些状态不能当成验收？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 schema 中 active、beta、archived 是有限字段，来源 official/community 也是元数据。结构验证无法证明工具可装、可运行或授权真实。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[catalog/schema.json:18-30](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/blob/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6/catalog/schema.json#L18-L30) 条目结构与状态枚举
查看原文（13行） ```text "plugins": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["name", "url", "category", "description"], "properties": { "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 }, "url": { "type": "string", "format": "uri" }, "category": { "type": "string" }, "description": { "$ref": "#/$defs/localizedText" }, "status": { "enum": ["active", "beta", "archived"] }, "source": { "type": "string", "enum": ["official", "community"] } } ```
#### 缺口 - 目标包运行未验。 **影响**：需要回源审查。 **进一步探讨**：挑一条过期候选核查。 ### Q04 · 采用和退出成本？ **研究主题**：依赖、兼容与流程、效果与总成本、采用判断 #### 完整回答 浏览固定 README 或读取 JSON 即可，无需向 DSH 安装目录。主要成本是时效和来源核对，退出移除索引依赖并保留研究来源。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[scripts/generate_readmes.py:16-23](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/blob/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6/scripts/generate_readmes.py#L16-L23) 本地 JSON 与页面输入输出 ```text ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] CATALOG_PATH = ROOT / "catalog" / "plugins.json" MARKERS = ("", "") LANGUAGES = ("en", "zh-CN") PAGES = {"zh-CN": ROOT / "docs" / "README.zh-CN.md"} SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$") STATUSES = {"active", "beta", "archived"} SOURCES = {"official", "community"} ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:6-10](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/blob/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6/README.md#L6-L10) 目录定位 ```text > A community-curated, vendor-neutral catalog of plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — from developer tooling and data workflows to media, operations, and everyday life. **Language:** English | [简体中文](docs/README.zh-CN.md) DeepSeek Harness plugins can connect an agent to tools, services, devices, and repeatable workflows. This list is intentionally broad: if it gives an agent a useful real-world capability, it belongs here. ``` #### 缺口 - 上游覆盖和更新延迟未知。 **影响**：不适合作唯一发现源。 **进一步探讨**：记录提交与候选日期。 ### Q05 · 怎样检验价值？ **研究主题**：新假设与验证 #### 完整回答 同需求比较自由搜索和分类查找，记录命中率、来源失效和时间。若双语不一致或目标无法定位，则当前索引需补核。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[scripts/generate_readmes.py:49-58](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/blob/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6/scripts/generate_readmes.py#L49-L58) 双语一致结构可验
查看原文（10行） ```text def require_localized(value: Any, label: str) -> dict[str, str]: if not isinstance(value, dict): fail(f"{label} must be an object with en and zh-CN text.") result: dict[str, str] = {} for language in LANGUAGES: text = value.get(language) if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip(): fail(f"{label}.{language} must be a non-empty string.") result[language] = text.strip() return result ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[catalog/schema.json:22-29](https://github.com/Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin/blob/3b44fe8ffddbf19ccebd459829e5a8ae2cbb0fa6/catalog/schema.json#L22-L29) 来源字段可比对 ```text "required": ["name", "url", "category", "description"], "properties": { "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 }, "url": { "type": "string", "format": "uri" }, "category": { "type": "string" }, "description": { "$ref": "#/$defs/localizedText" }, "status": { "enum": ["active", "beta", "archived"] }, "source": { "type": "string", "enum": ["official", "community"] } ``` #### 缺口 - 尚无对照数据。 **影响**：发现便利可与软件质量分开计量。 **进一步探讨**：保留人工判定表。 ## 工程统计 统计范围：git tracked files at exact commit; component scope only；组件：根；内容摘要：988a3f80565e441a544fec41fef432ccc5b129fa5f3f05dd0c91ffacfb149024。sloc 0.3.2，TypeScript 5.9.3。 仅统计 Markdown 和指定的 JavaScript／TypeScript 扩展名；Python 等其他语言不纳入，表格不代表全语言代码规模。 | 扩展名 | 范围 | 文件数 | 总行 | 代码行 | 注释行 | 字数 | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | .md | source | 4 | 546 | — | — | 6402 | 排除 0 项，解析错误 0 项；默认排除规则是启发式，源文件与打包产物可能重复，不能从行数推算原创量或工时。Markdown 字数与代码行分别计量，未知不填0。 ## 能力清单 | 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 | | --- | --- | --- | | GitHub 自由搜索。 | 可直接比较 | 保留人工步骤 | | Awesome DSH Plugin | 统一双语目录及可复查元数据。 | 收录状态需回到实际包核验。 | ## 工程亮点 有结构及重复字段检查。 ## 验证与边界 - 已检查：作者 README、包清单、源码路径 README.md、scripts/generate_readmes.py、catalog/schema.json 及固定范围 inventory；组件：仓库根。抽读不冒充完整审计，来源和原文嵌入正式快照时保留。 - 未执行：插件安装、目标代码与测试、真实宿主及模型任务。源码存在不等于运行通过。 - 边界：静态核查固定提交的按用途定位可独立核查的插件来源。未执行目标代码或实际宿主验证。 - 下一步：保留人工判定表。

[![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)
[![Contributions welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/contributions-welcome-brightgreen.svg?style=flat-square)](CONTRIBUTING.md)

> A community-curated, vendor-neutral catalog of plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — from developer tooling and data workflows to media, operations, and everyday life.

**Language:** English | [简体中文](docs/README.zh-CN.md)

DeepSeek Harness plugins can connect an agent to tools, services, devices, and repeatable workflows. This list is intentionally broad: if it gives an agent a useful real-world capability, it belongs here.

## Getting started

1. Browse a category below and open a plugin's repository or marketplace page.
2. Follow that plugin's installation instructions for DeepSeek Harness.
3. Restart or reload DeepSeek Harness if the plugin requires it.

> The catalog links to third-party projects. Review a plugin's source, permissions, and data-handling policy before installing it.

## Add a plugin

Additions are welcome. Please read [the contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md). The English catalog in this README is maintained by hand. Add matching bilingual metadata to [`catalog/plugins.json`](catalog/plugins.json) to update the Simplified Chinese mirror, then run:

```bash
python scripts/generate_readmes.py
python scripts/generate_readmes.py --check
```

The first command regenerates the Simplified Chinese mirror; the second validates its catalog data and verifies that mirror is current.

## Catalog rules

- The plugin must be relevant to DeepSeek Harness or provide clear installation/integration instructions for it.
- Entries need a stable public URL, a concise factual description, and both English and Simplified Chinese copy.
- Keep entries vendor-neutral, useful, and non-duplicative.
- Do not include secrets, affiliate links, unmaintained forks without context, or projects that primarily distribute malware, credential theft, or policy-violating automation.

"""Validate bilingual catalog metadata and render the Simplified Chinese index."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urlparse


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CATALOG_PATH = ROOT / "catalog" / "plugins.json"
MARKERS = ("<!-- CATALOG:START -->", "<!-- CATALOG:END -->")
LANGUAGES = ("en", "zh-CN")
PAGES = {"zh-CN": ROOT / "docs" / "README.zh-CN.md"}
SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$")
STATUSES = {"active", "beta", "archived"}
SOURCES = {"official", "community"}
EMPTY_MESSAGES = {
    "en": "No entries yet. [Submit the first plugin.](CONTRIBUTING.md)",
    "zh-CN": "暂未收录。欢迎[提交第一个 Plugin](../CONTRIBUTING.md)。",
}


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise ValueError(message)


def load_catalog() -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        catalog = json.loads(CATALOG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
        fail(f"Invalid JSON in {CATALOG_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)}: {error}")

    if not isinstance(catalog, dict):
        fail("Catalog root must be an object.")
    if not isinstance(catalog.get("categories"), list):
        fail("Catalog must contain a categories array.")
    if not isinstance(catalog.get("plugins"), list):
        fail("Catalog must contain a plugins array.")
    return catalog


def require_localized(value: Any, label: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        fail(f"{label} must be an object with en and zh-CN text.")
    result: dict[str, str] = {}
    for language in LANGUAGES:
        text = value.get(language)
        if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
            fail(f"{label}.{language} must be a non-empty string.")
        result[language] = text.strip()
    return result


def validate(catalog: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]]:
    categories: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    category_ids: set[str] = set()
    for index, category in enumerate(catalog["categories"], start=1):
        label = f"categories[{index}]"
        if not isinstance(category, dict):
            fail(f"{label} must be an object.")
        category_id = category.get("id")
        if not isinstance(category_id, str) or not SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(category_id):
            fail(f"{label}.id must be a lowercase kebab-case string.")
        if category_id in category_ids:
            fail(f"Duplicate category id: {category_id}")
        category_ids.add(category_id)
        categories.append({"id": category_id, "title": require_localized(category.get("title"), f"{label}.title")})

    grouped: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    names: set[str] = set()
    urls: set[str] = set()
    for index, plugin in enumerate(catalog["plugins"], start=1):
        label = f"plugins[{index}]"
        if not isinstance(plugin, dict):
            fail(f"{label} must be an object.")
        name = plugin.get("name")
        url = plugin.get("url")
        category = plugin.get("category")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
            fail(f"{label}.name must be a non-empty string.")
        if name.casefold() in names:
            fail(f"Duplicate plugin name: {name}")
        names.add(name.casefold())
        if not isinstance(url, str) or urlparse(url).scheme not in {"https", "http"} or not urlparse(url).netloc:
            fail(f"{label}.url must be an absolute http(s) URL.")
        if url in urls:
            fail(f"Duplicate plugin URL: {url}")
        urls.add(url)
        if category not in category_ids:
            fail(f"{label}.category must reference a declared category.")
        status = plugin.get("status", "active")
        source = plugin.get("source", "community")
        if status not in STATUSES:
            fail(f"{label}.status must be one of: {', '.join(sorted(STATUSES))}.")
        if source not in SOURCES:
            fail(f"{label}.source must be one of: {', '.join(sorted(SOURCES))}.")
        grouped[category].append(
            {
                "name": name.strip(),
                "url": url,
                "description": require_localized(plugin.get("description"), f"{label}.description"),
                "status": status,
                "source": source,
            }
        )

    for entries in grouped.values():
        entries.sort(key=lambda entry: entry["name"].casefold())
    return categories, grouped


def escape_markdown(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("[", "\\[").replace("]", "\\]").replace("\n", " ")


def render_catalog(language: str, categories: list[dict[str, Any]], grouped: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]) -> str:
    sections: list[str] = []
    for category in categories:
        sections.append(f"### {category['title'][language]}")
        entries = grouped[category["id"]]
        if not entries:
            sections.append(EMPTY_MESSAGES[language])
            continue
        for entry in entries:
            suffix: list[str] = []
            if entry["status"] != "active":
                suffix.append(entry["status"])
            if entry["source"] == "official":
                suffix.append("official")
            label = f" ({', '.join(suffix)})" if suffix else ""
            sections.append(
                f"- [{escape_markdown(entry['name'])}]({entry['url']}) — "
                f"{escape_markdown(entry['description'][language])}{label}"
            )
    return "\n\n".join(sections)


def update_page(path: Path, rendered_catalog: str, check: bool) -> bool:
    content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    start, end = MARKERS
    if content.count(start) != 1 or content.count(end) != 1:
        fail(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)} must contain one pair of catalog markers.")
    before, remainder = content.split(start, 1)
    _, after = remainder.split(end, 1)
    expected = f"{before}{start}\n{rendered_catalog}\n{end}{after}"
    if content == expected:
        return False
    if check:
        print(f"Out of date: {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
        return True
    path.write_text(expected, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Updated: {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    return True


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="Fail if generated pages are out of date.")
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        categories, grouped = validate(load_catalog())
        changed = False
        for language, path in PAGES.items():
            changed = update_page(path, render_catalog(language, categories, grouped), arguments.check) or changed
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print(f"Catalog validation failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if arguments.check and changed:
        print("Run: python scripts/generate_readmes.py", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("Catalog is valid and generated pages are current.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
